## About

James Tannahill - jamestannahill.com
AI/ML for Capital Markets at SpaceX Super Intelligence. Formerly President and Managing Partner, Plocamium Holdings, and Head of Field Operations, ProSecPR. Builder of 1ness Strategies and NewYorkLab.
